ja.title: PK/PD・PopPK・PBPK・QSPの使い分けを目的とデータから考える
ja.summary: PK/PD、母集団PK、PBPK、QSPの目的、入力データ、解析対象、結果の読み方、判断の限界を比較する。架空のPK/PDと集団分布の例を使い、個人差・診断・外挿を考える。

en.title: PK/PD, population PK, PBPK and QSP: purposes, data and interpretation
en.summary: A Japanese guide comparing purposes, input data, model development, diagnostics and limits of PK/PD, population PK, PBPK and QSP. Three original figures include hypothetical PK/PD dynamics and analytical conditional population distributions. No empirical model estimation or real-drug validation is claimed.
en.seo_title: PK/PD, PopPK, PBPK and QSP: questions and evidence
en.seo_description: Compare model purposes, data, variability, outputs and validation. Synthetic examples separate shared PK from different PD and conditional population spread.
